Now this is your money melon!|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Roasted Hydromelons are a type of [[Roasted Food]], resulting from [[Hydromelon]]s that have made contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} Roasted Hydromelons have soft, flaky flesh and an intriguing flavor. [[Link]] can restore three quarters of a [[Heart]] to his [[Life Gauge]] by eating a Roasted Hydromelon. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Roasted Hydromelons return in {{TotK}} as a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They are created when [[Hydromelon]]s come into contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. The process of roasting a Hydromelon results in soft, flaky flesh with an flavor known to be intriguing. If [[Link]] eats a Roasted Hydromelon, he will be able to restore three quarters of a [[Heart]] to his [[Life Gauge]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Hydromelon * Roasted Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
